discussion_comments.comment_body:
Yes, we're just trying to update the version. I've got a requirement to allow customers to upgrade their existing packet core version using a template since some customers are only using the quickstart templates to manage their resources.

If we use a simple template which just declares a packet core control plane object, the UX is poor since it requires the user to re-enter all the existing configuration. Therefore, I've written this template which gets those values from the existing object, so the user just needs to enter the desired version.

Does that seem ok to you? Or do you think we need to use the simple template and require the user to fill all the fields?
